how to become a regular at
your favourite café

1. same day, same time,
every week

2. learn the barista's name,
and use it

3. sit at the counter,
not in the corner

5. leave your phone
in your bag

6. have something to talk about

a painting, a city, a strange fact.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. have something to talk about

i learn one thing every morning
on a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
